excerpt: execSync('npm run build', { cwd: pluginDir, stdio: 'inherit' });
sink: child_process.execSync runs 'npm run build' with cwd set to the caller-supplied, path.resolve'd pluginPath; only fs.pathExists(pluginDir) is checked beforehand, not that the directory is actually a plugin this server created.
guard: partial: existence check only, no verification the directory contains an expected package.json/build script from this tool, and no restriction of pluginPath to any base directory

This is the tool's advertised purpose (build a plugin project) but with no check that the target is actually a legitimate/expected plugin directory, so it will run any accessible directory's build script -- and, combined with create_plugin's CWE-94 finding, completes an end-to-end RCE chain.

sink: path is appended as a raw positional argument to ["git","diff"] (and ["git","diff","--cached"]) run via subprocess.run with no shell and no leading "--" separator between options and pathspecs, so git parses a value starting with "-" as a CLI option rather than a path.
